rationale: The evaluator feedback suggests increasing kd from 0.25 to 0.28 to improve damping and reduce oscillations, adjusting sensor_weights to [-0.25, 0.65, -0.25] to emphasize the center sensor more for better line detection, and changing line_loss strategy to 'search_right' to potentially improve recovery from line loss events. I implemented these changes while keeping other parameters stable, including base_speed at 0.75, ki at 0.04, and kp at 0.48, as these were reasonable in the previous candidate. Geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations, improve line tracking stability, and enhance recovery from line loss, leading to better overall performance and generalization on unseen tracks. For the next measurement, I request telemetry on completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify the impact of these changes and guide further tuning if needed.
